import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"]
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: build STG_NEW
    stg = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    stg_new = (
        stg.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], dropna=False)
        .agg(
            total_qty=("qty", "sum"),
            max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    stg_new = stg_new[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    # Step 2: delete rows from TARGET_SNAPSHOT whose batch_date appears in STG_NEW
    arriving_dates = stg_new["batch_date"].unique()
    remaining = target_snapshot[~target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(arriving_dates)]

    # Step 3: insert STG_NEW rows
    result = pd.concat(
        [remaining[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]], stg_new],
        ignore_index=True,
    )

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
